rubrics.justification: Accurately describes a hatching/expanded 4AA blastocyst with compact ICM, cohesive TE, and thin/breached zona; minor overinterpretation of exact image quadrants/crops.
Strong integration of age-related aneuploidy risk, prior live birth, low oocyte yield, endometriosis, endometrium, sperm quality, BMI, and lifestyle with embryo morphology and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and well structured, especially around morphology versus maternal age; slight issue because the probability section is truncated and shifts from implantation framing to live birth probability.

Generally consistent with Gardner grading and standard IVF principles, especially emphasizing maternal age/aneuploidy over morphology alone; limited by incomplete recommendations and some broad statements.
Provides interpretation and prognosis but the response is truncated before clear transfer/future-cycle recommendations, so practical next steps are limited.
